snippet.title: DREGS - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
In DREGS, you and your crew are sent into the void as disposable scavengers working for a mysterious collector who only cares about one thing: what you bring back.

Valuable tech. Strange artifacts. Questionable decisions. If it's still floating out there, it's probably worth risking your life for. After all, you can be replaced. 😏

Explore abandoned ships, crawl through dark corridors, and solve deadly puzzles while your oxygen supply slowly becomes everyone's problem. And most of all, fight the real enemy: the bad decisions you and your friends make!

Someone always pushes the wrong button. Someone always says ""trust me", someone is already carrying something they absolutely should not have touched.

Every expedition is one mistake away from turning into a disaster you’ll be laughing about… or screaming through. 

Some crews coordinate. Some panic. The best do both at the same time.
